issues.description: Shelf-space calculation method is ambiguous; the spec permits estimation but lacks an agreed algorithm (matches CAND-00015).
issues.suggested_fix: Require explicit estimation algorithm for shelf-space (dimensions, proxies, or alternative) and document methodology.

issues.description: Capacity metrics definition is ambiguous (which physical or system capacity metrics to display). It is referenced by CAND-00067 and CAND-00008 lacking a single definition.
issues.suggested_fix: Define a single, concrete set of capacity metrics (e.g., shelf space, item-count thresholds, load factors) and align all capacity-related candidates.

issues.description: Default archival retention policy values are not specified (CAND-00131 and CAND-00215 are open questions about policy defaults).
issues.suggested_fix: Decide and document default retention periods (e.g., 7 years for financial/audit data) and provide guidance for configuration.
